Introduction
This document lists the equipment 
inspection checklist I2,
which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Safety Precaution
A work permit must be issued.
Wear your safety helmet & safety
 harnesses.
Safety
 fence with caution marks around the work area is required.
CB
 most be isolated and proper earthing at the two sides.
Isolate
 control circuit (DC voltage).
Inter

 purpose.
Use
 only fiberglass ladders.
Personnel
 carrying out the maintenance should be trained and qualified or directly
 supervised by some one who is.
Environmental Recommendation
Using
 solvents such as gasoline and others for cleaning the oil filter is
 dangerous, it will expose lungs to very hazardous and carcinogenic
 chemicals. You have to wear your breathing mask.
Don't
 burn the cloth used in cleaning; collect it and send it to the dump.
